'''Taspan II''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in the [[Taspan system]], in the [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]]. The [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] had a [[Imperial weapons facility|weapons facility]] on the planet, where [[Gravity well projector/Legends|gravity well projectors]] were tested by Imperial [[Scientist/Legends|scientists]]. However, the facility was abandoned and the planet destroyed during the cataclysmic [[Big Crush]]. After the destruction of Taspan II, [[Unidentified debris field|floating debris]] from the former planet played a role in the [[Battle of Mindor]] in [[5 ABY/Legends|5 ABY]] and the subsequent destruction of the [[Star system/Legends|system]].

==Description==
Taspan II was the second [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in the [[Taspan system]]&mdash;located in the [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]]&mdash;revolving around the [[Star/Legends|star]] [[Taspan]]. It was, at one point, hospitable enough to support a full staff of [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] [[Scientist/Legends|scientists]], who tested [[Gravity well projector/Legends|gravity well projectors]] on the planet. But after the [[Big Crush]], the planet was torn apart into fragments and sent hurtling through the [[Star system/Legends|system]]. By the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Battle of Mindor]], the [[Asteroid/Legends|asteroids]] still had not had enough time to stabilize into a settled [[Orbit/Legends|orbit]], and were still flying through the system, making travel through the vicinity of the former planet very hazardous.<ref name="Shadows of Mindor" />

Before the time of the Big Crush, a group of [[Melter]]s, energy-based beings that lived in a natural substance called [[meltmassif]], resided on the planet. They lived on Taspan II for millennia until the Big Crush, and survived on the fragments of Taspan II afterward.<ref name="Shadows of Mindor" />

==History==
[[File:ShadowSpawnZoom.jpg|thumb|right|250px|The warlord Shadowspawn used the debris of Taspan II to his advantage.]]
At some point before [[5 ABY/Legends|5 ABY]],<ref name="TERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates the events of ''[[Luke Skywalker and the Shadows of Mindor]]'' to [[5 ABY/Legends|5 ABY]]. The novel states that the [[Big Crush]] happened four [[Standard year/Legends|years]] before the events described, placing it in [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]].</ref> the Galactic Empire had a presence on Taspan II in the form of a [[Imperial weapons facility|weapons facility]], where the Empire tested various designs of gravity well projectors.<ref name="Shadows of Mindor" /> In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="TERC" /> the facility was abandoned after the Big Crush, a cataclysmic event where the planet was torn to pieces after a mishap while testing a gravity well projector. Afterward, all that was left of Taspan II was an [[Unidentified debris field|asteroid field]], akin to [[the Graveyard]] of [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]]. The debris from Taspan II's destruction had not had time to stabilize as of 5 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|ABY]], and debris was still hurtling through the Taspan system, making its sister planet [[Mindor/Legends|Mindor]], also known as Taspan I, almost inaccessible.<ref name="Shadows of Mindor" />

The debris was later used to the advantage of Empire [[Warlord/Legends|warlord]] [[Cronal|Shadowspawn]] during his campaign against the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]]<ref name="Shadows of Mindor" /> in 5 ABY.<ref name="TERC" /> Shadowspawn set up his main base of operations on the former resort planet of Mindor, hidden by the flying asteroids. While discussing the warlord's base, [[New Republic pilot/Legends|New Republic pilot]] [[Wedge Antilles/Legends|Wedge Antilles]] compared the debris of Taspan II to the [[The Graveyard|Graveyard of Alderaan]], but [[General/Legends|General]] [[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando Calrissian]] claimed that Taspan was far worse.<ref name="Shadows of Mindor" /> In 5 ABY,<ref name="TERC" /> the New Republic battled Shadowspawn's forces at Mindor, led by [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi General]] [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]]. During the Battle of Mindor, the culmination of Shadowspawn's efforts, planetesimals in the Taspan system, including the fragments of Taspan II, were captured by the gravitational pull of the star Taspan. The impact of the fragments making contact with the star emitted hard radiation and flares, which tore through Mindor's surface.<ref name="Shadows of Mindor" />

==Behind the scenes==
Taspan II was mentioned in [[Matthew Stover]]'s novel ''[[Luke Skywalker and the Shadows of Mindor]]'', released in [[2008]].<ref name="Shadows of Mindor" /> The [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' placed the Taspan system, and therefore Taspan II, in grid square M-8.<ref name="Atlas" />
